thought.text: The Rails app (Puma) is booted. Let me verify the HTTP endpoint.

reasoning_content: Rails app is up and running, Puma is listening. Wait a sec, it's showing "Listening on http://0.0.0.0:8080" — hmm, but the container should be exposing port 80. Maybe Puma is running on 8080 internally and apache is proxying to it. Let me check the HTTP response from localhost:8080.

action.command: sleep 20; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code} (redirect: %{redirect_url})\n" --max-time 30 http://localhost:8080/; curl -s --max-time 30 http://localhost:8080/ | head -c 1500
